ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the horizontal axis of Figure 7 is horizontal distance/m, representing the positions from left to right along the slope surface direction; the right vertical axis is labeled erosion amount, and the black shading below the 0 line in the figure represents the size of the erosion amount at different horizontal distances. The black shading is shallower at both ends of the slope surface and extends downward deepest near the middle of the slope surface. Then reason: understand the slope surface from left to right along the horizontal axis as the upper section, middle section, and lower section; compare the downward depth of the black shading—the deeper the shading, the greater the erosion amount. The deepest part in the figure is located near the middle of the slope surface, therefore the most seriously eroded is the middle section of the slope surface.
